13: - **NO Em-dashes (—).** Use commas or periods.

#!/bin/bash

# Navigate to the project directory
cd "/Users/jaikumardewani/Projects/AI blogs"

# Configure standard path to include user-installed tools and python3
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

echo "=========================================="
echo "Starting Blog Automation: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

# Run the python generation script
python3 scripts/generate_blog.py

# Capture exit code of the python script
EXIT_CODE=$?

if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Generation script finished successfully. Checking git status..."
  
  # Find any new files under content/blog/
  # E.g. ?? content/blog/my-slug/index.md
  NEW_FILE=$(git status --porcelain content/blog/ | grep -E '^\?\?|^ A' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}')
  
  if [ -n "$NEW_FILE" ]; then
    # Extract slug (strip content/blog/ prefix and any trailing paths)
    SLUG="${NEW_FILE#content/blog/}"
    SLUG="${SLUG%%/*}"
    
    echo "New blog post detected for slug: '$SLUG'"
    echo "Staging files..."
    git add content/blog/
    
    # Use caveman-commit style message
    COMMIT_MSG="add blog post about $SLUG"
    echo "Committing with message: '$COMMIT_MSG'"
    git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"
    
    echo "Pushing to GitHub..."
    git push origin main
    
    echo "Done! Post pushed and deployment triggered on GitHub Pages."
  else
    echo "No new blog posts were found in git status."
  fi
else
  echo "ERROR: Generation script failed with exit code $EXIT_CODE."
fi

echo "=========================================="
echo "Blog Automation Completed: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

name: AI Blog Generator

on:
  schedule:
    # 3:30 AM UTC = 9:00 AM IST
    # 11:30 AM UTC = 5:00 PM IST
    - cron: '30 3,11 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

jobs:
  generate-blog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Generate Blog Post (Cloud API)
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/generate_blog_cloud.py

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          # Check if there are any new files in content/blog/
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain content/blog/)" ]; then
            echo "New blog post detected, preparing to commit..."
            
            git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            
            # Extract slug robustly before staging
            LATEST_SLUG=$(git status --porcelain content/blog/ | grep -E '^\?\?|^ A' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}')
            SLUG="${LATEST_SLUG#content/blog/}"
            SLUG="${SLUG%%/*}"
            
            git add content/blog/
            COMMIT_MSG="add blog post about $SLUG"
            echo "Committing with message: '$COMMIT_MSG'"
            git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"
            
            echo "Pushing to main branch..."
            git push origin main
            
            # We set an environment variable for the next step so it knows we pushed
            echo "PUSHED_NEW_POST=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "No new blog post was generated. Exiting."
            echo "PUSHED_NEW_POST=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Trigger Gatsby Publish Workflow
        if: env.PUSHED_NEW_POST == 'true'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Trigger the deploy workflow to publish the site and send the notification
          echo "Triggering the Gatsby Publish workflow to deploy the new post..."
          gh workflow run "Gatsby Publish" --ref main

      - name: Notify on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          NTFY_TOPIC=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('config.json')).get('ntfy_topic', ''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ -n "$NTFY_TOPIC" ] && [ "$NTFY_TOPIC" != "None" ]; then
            echo "Sending failure notification to ntfy.sh topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
            curl -s \
              -H "Title: Blog generation FAILED" \
              -H "Priority: 5" \
              -H "Tags: warning,x" \
              -d "The AI Blog Generator workflow failed. Check GitHub Actions for details." \
              "https://ntfy.sh/$NTFY_TOPIC"
          fi
